page.notes: The Syriac and Hebrew-pointed words are printed in Syriac and Hebrew letters that could not be read reliably at this scan resolution, so they are marked illegible. Some Hebrew and Syriac characters inside the lines may also be partly lost. The faint mirrored text in the right half of the scan is show-through and is not transcribed. The page number 589 and the signature EEe 3 are taken from the foot and head of the page.
